headline.title: Rossellini at Film Forum, 26 films
headline.body: Rome Open City, Paisan and Voyage to Italy in 35mm and new 4K restorations. A gray Monday is a good excuse to start.

picks.title: Lightscape at Brooklyn Botanic Garden
picks.body: The garden's winter light trail runs to Jan 3. Timed tickets are bought in advance online, and popular nights can sell out.

picks.title: Bank of America Winter Village, Bryant Park
picks.body: Free skating, with the holiday shops open through Jan 3. The rink stays open until midnight from Nov 19 to Jan 3.

picks.title: Faces: Moving-Image Portraiture
picks.body: Anthology Film Archives surveys how filmmakers have shot the human face, through Dec 1. Check the calendar for the lineup.

picks.title: Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses
picks.body: The Brooklyn Museum's show of the Dutch designer's couture, 140-plus pieces, closes Dec 6.

picks.title: The Photography Triennial: After Dark
picks.body: The Museum of the City of New York looks at the city's nightlife through contemporary photography. Opened Nov 20.
picks.place: Museum of the City of New York, East Harlem

picks.title: Lucy Dacus at Music Hall of Williamsburg
picks.body: The indie songwriter plays the 550-capacity Williamsburg room on Monday, Nov 30. Doors at 8 PM.

picks.title: Sonia Boyce: Demonstrate
picks.body: The Queens Museum hosts the British artist's show, on view through Jan 27, 2027. Listed in Hyperallergic's fall 2026 art guide.

picks.title: Greenpoint-McCarren Park Greenmarket
picks.body: The Saturday farmers market sets up on Union Avenue between Driggs and N 12th Street.

picks.title: Shop Small Greenpoint Fall Retail Crawl
picks.body: Pick up a passport at any participating shop and collect stamps across 60-plus Greenpoint businesses over nine days.

picks.title: Brooklyn Flea holiday market, DUMBO
picks.body: The Flea's December edition at the DUMBO Archway runs Dec 5 to 20, free entry, no food booths.

facts.t: The Greenpoint Avenue Bridge over Newtown Creek is the sixth span at that spot. Its official name is the J.J. Byrne Bridge, for a Brooklyn Borough President.

countdowns.title: 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
countdowns.body: Thursday, 8:30 AM to noon, from 77th Street to Herald Square. Free on the sidewalk.

countdowns.title: Shop Small Greenpoint crawl begins
countdowns.body: Nine days of stamps and prizes at 60-plus Greenpoint shops, Nov 28 to Dec 6.

countdowns.title: Rockefeller Center tree lighting
countdowns.body: The 2026 ceremony is Wednesday, Dec 2. Free, first come, first served.
